subject: Kickoff: LEGO multi-hop KGQA on the entity graph
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off LEGO. The open-source release does latent execution-guided reasoning for multi-hop question answering on knowledge graphs (ICML'21 method), and the language portfolio wants it pointed at our internal entity graph — think support queries like "which customers on plan X filed tickets about feature Y" answered by traversal rather than a monolithic LLM call.

Milestones:
- Mar 20: repo building cleanly, including the smore submodule (git submodule update --init, then pip install -e .) and the example scripts under lego/experiments/scripts.
- Apr 24: baseline multi-hop accuracy on a frozen slice of the entity graph.
- May 29: go/no-go for productization, tied to launch review calendar.

Deshawn will send the staffing plan. Rafael is research lead.

Priya
